theme: Review Gate and Guard Advisory Honesty

shots.title: Reword non-blocking guard advisories as explicit advisory context (#579)

hazards.description: The issue described v1.58.3 behavior, while current claim-required can genuinely ask or deny through the host adapter; the fix had to label each current enforcement mode instead of assuming every message was advisory.

shots.notes: scope-drift and phase-boundary fallback messages now identify themselves as non-blocking and explain that they do not grant or deny host tool permission. Phase-boundary coverage also confirms project-specific sprint fields are not required.

shots.title: Clarify that SLOPE claims do not control host permission prompts (#579)
shots.notes: claim-required now distinguishes an ask-mode SLOPE permission request from a non-blocking missing-claim advisory and states that claims record scope without replacing host permission policy.

shots.title: Require an explicit waiver path for required-review self-review downgrades (#578)
shots.notes: review recommend persists required/recommended/optional gate requirements. Required review gates reject ordinary self-review/manual override and accept only independent evidence, PR evidence, or the distinct independent_review_waived provenance with a reason.

shots.title: Surface required-review next actions in sprint status, slope now, and PR guidance (#578)

hazards.description: The first dogfood run prioritized the waiver in slope now but still printed a stale Start next-ticket command beneath it.

shots.notes: sprint status, slope now, session briefing, completion guidance, registry help, and commit-ready guidance now keep required-review waivers visibly distinct, suppress contradictory ticket-start guidance, and tell operators how to replace a waiver with independent evidence.

conditions.description: The architecture recovery train is stacked on the unmerged but clean S223 draft PR so completed issue work is not duplicated.

training.description: Agent-facing enforcement text must be derived from the actual GuardResult decision, not from a guard's historical reputation.
training.outcome: Advisory, ask, and deny paths now use enforcement-specific language and tests.

training.description: A review recommendation cannot constrain later gate completion unless its requiredness is persisted beside sprint state.
training.outcome: review recommend now records gate priorities durably and gate mutation enforces them.

training.description: A mechanical completion bit and an assurance disposition are different concepts.
training.outcome: Required review waivers can complete the gate while producing a distinct ready_for_pr_with_review_waiver state and visible downgrade markers.

nutrition.description: Focused S224 lifecycle and guard suites passed: 245 tests across 11 files.
Full Vitest passed: 238 files and 3758 tests, with 25 store-pg tests skipped by configuration.
Typecheck and build passed, including packages/pi-extension.
Roadmap validation passed after triaging #584/#585/#586 into S228-S232 and recording #580 as already fixed by S216.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: The small wording issue exposed a deeper state-model gap, and the sprint closed both without conflating SLOPE claims with host authorization.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When a CLI recommendation says required, persist that decision before offering completion commands; otherwise the later gate cannot protect the intent.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: claim-required had evolved from non-blocking advice into a configurable ask/deny guard, so the issue's original blanket characterization was no longer accurate.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: The remaining train can now use the new waiver path honestly while repairing workflow, scorecard, review, and roadmap architecture.

bunker_locations: Guard copy must name the enforcement mode actually returned to the harness.
Review requiredness must be durable state, not transient terminal output.
A required-review waiver should remain mechanically complete but visibly downgraded across every operator surface.
yardage_book_updates: src/cli/sprint-state.ts now stores review requirements and independent_review_waived provenance.
src/cli/commands/review-state.ts persists review recommendation priority into matching sprint state.
src/cli/commands/sprint.ts enforces and renders the required-review waiver distinction.
Guard and cockpit surfaces now state enforcement and downgrade semantics explicitly.
course_management_notes: S224 is stacked on S223 because PR #577 remains open and green; no merge is implied.
The full suite, typecheck, build, focused suites, and roadmap validation passed before closeout.

The required architect review cannot be delegated under the current tool policy without an explicit user request, so closeout records an independent-review waiver rather than presenting self-review as equivalent evidence.
